action.summary: Delete `unused-total` from src/ledger/dead_export.clj if nothing outside the repository uses it, or import src/ledger/dead_export.clj where `unused-total` is meant to be called.

findings.detail: No import in the repository resolves to src/ledger/dead_export.clj or another file of its module, and nothing in it is an entry point, test, or framework hook. If `unused-total` is part of a library's public API this is expected; in an application it is dead, along with whatever only it calls.
findings.title: `ledger.dead-export/unused-total` is exported but no import resolves to src/ledger/dead_export.clj

action.summary: Delete `forgotten-rate` from src/ledger/dead_helpers.clj if nothing outside the repository uses it, or import src/ledger/dead_helpers.clj where `forgotten-rate` is meant to be called.

findings.detail: No import in the repository resolves to src/ledger/dead_helpers.clj or another file of its module, and nothing in it is an entry point, test, framework hook, or export, so no root reaches `forgotten-rate`. Cupel sees imports between files, not calls, so this holds for the whole file; module-level code, a script run directly, or loading by computed name (reflection, `getattr`, string-keyed registries, dynamic imports) could still reach it.
findings.title: `ledger.dead-helpers/forgotten-rate` is unreachable: no import resolves to src/ledger/dead_helpers.clj
